title: PAC Learning with Multiple Correct Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.05133v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study PAC learning when each example comes with a set of at most $\ell$ correct labels and a prediction is correct if it belongs to this set. Training may reveal the full set, only whether a proposed label is correct (bandit feedback), or one correct label chosen by a demonstrator (demonstrations). Our main finding is that demonstrations can be much harder than full sets, and even than bandit feedback, both in which classes can be learned and in how many examples are needed. For finite label spaces, a generalized Natarajan dimension characterizes learnability from full sets and from bandit feedback, in both the realizable and the agnostic setting. From demonstrations, however, a class is realizably learnable if and only if the intersections of at most $\ell+1$ of its hypotheses are learnable from full sets. Already with three labels, this condition can fail for a class learnable from a single full-set example or even a single band

translated_title: 具有多个正确答案的PAC学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了每个样本带有至多 $\ell$ 个正确标签集合的PAC学习问题，只要预测的标签属于该集合即视为正确。训练过程中可能揭示完整标签集合、仅反馈所提出的标签是否正确（bandit反馈），或者由示范者给出的一个正确标签（示范）。我们的主要发现是：示范学习可能比完整标签集合难得多，甚至比bandit反馈更难，这种困难体现在可学习的类别以及所需样本数量两个方面。对于有限标签空间，一个广义的Natarajan维度刻画了在可实现和不可知（agnostic）两种设定下，从完整标签集合和从bandit反馈学习的可学习性。然而，对于示范学习，一个类是可实现的（realizably）可学习的当且仅当其至多 $\ell+1$ 个假设的交集可以从完整标签集合学习。仅使用三个标签时，该条件对于一个可以从单个完整标签集合样本（甚至单个bandit反馈样本）学习的类就可能不成立。
tldr: 该论文研究了每个样本允许多个正确标签的PAC学习问题，证明了示范反馈可能比完整标签集合甚至bandit反馈学习更困难，并用广义Natarajan维度刻画了前两种反馈下的可学习性，用假设交集的可学习性刻画了示范学习下的可学习性。
